The file on disk contains different content than what I wrote — it appears the workspace already contained a `reports/export.py` with a different implementation (quoting applied to `str()`-converted values, and no special-case for empty columns), and my second write did not take effect as intended. The pre-existing `tests/test_export.py` pins the intended behavior:

1. Empty columns → header and each record is a bare `"\r\n"` (so `[{"a":1},{"a":2}], []` → `"\r\n\r\n"`).
2. Quoting applies only to values that are strings *before* conversion; `str(value)` results are emitted as-is even if they contain commas.
